differences.what: Five storeys and an attic of frieze windows under a bracketed cornice, the Lake Street front square to the camera and the Dearborn Street front running away to the right, with their window rows, where the stereograph shows them
The columned porch and balcony over the Dearborn Street entrance
The octagonal belvedere with its railed gallery and little dome, and the flagpole, on the roof behind the corner
The ground floor's shop fronts are drawn as plain glazed bays; the stereograph's signs, awnings and doorways differ in detail
The cornice and window dressings are lighter in tone than the photograph's painted wood or iron
Its balcony's railing is now built open, rails, bars and posts, as the picture draws it, where it was a solid band (T-3688, the landmarks' shared railing)

_how: verdict is unreviewed | differs | matches, set by whoever compared the side-by-side with the picture; each difference is {what, status: open | fixed | not shown | within tolerance | owner ruling} — open only if a street visitor would notice it (over about 1 ft, missing, mis-shaped, miscounted, wrong material or colour), else within tolerance (T-3153); owner ruling where the owner asked the build to depart from the picture (T-3236). A ticket whose ## Image gate names this building does not close while it is not "matches" (tools/image_gate.mjs).
